夜风有点大。

深圳湾某私人游艇会顶层露台。深灰色的防腐木地板上，只摆着一张桌子。

顾城穿了件深色的休闲西装，没打领带，领口微微敞开。林川更随意，白衬衫挽着袖子，手腕上那块百达翡丽在昏暗的射灯下泛着冷光。

桌上放着一瓶年份极好的罗曼尼康帝。

服务员小心翼翼地走过来倒酒，手腕微微发紧。她在这个会所工作了两年，见过不少大老板。但今天这桌的两个人，太年轻了。但是压迫感却十足，尤其是穿白衬衫的那位。

顾城端起酒杯，晃了晃暗红色的液体。

“你最近，可是把深圳的池子搅得不轻啊。”

顾城看着林川，语气像是在开玩笑，但眼神很深。

林川靠在沙发上，单手夹着烟。

“赚点零花钱。”

林川端起杯子，跟顾城碰了一下。声音清脆。

“零花钱？”顾城气笑了，抿了一口酒，“一亿八千五百多万的零花钱。林川，你这胃口，别说在深圳，放眼全国也没几个人敢这么说。”

林川没接话，抽了一口烟，淡蓝色的烟雾被海风迅速吹散。

顾城放下酒杯，身体微微前倾。

“说实话，你拿一千万去砸腾讯的股份，一开始我觉得你眼光毒，胆子大。”

顾城盯着林川的眼睛。

“但亿安科技这一手，我真没看懂。三千万本金，全仓压进去。中间三次洗盘，跌停板都摸了，你连动都没动一下。这时候我觉得，你是个疯子。”

顾城摇了摇头。

“但昨天下午，尾盘那十分钟。一亿八千多万的盘子，顶着几百万的滑点损耗，你连眼睛都不眨，直接市价不计成本往下砸。”

顾城深吸了一口气。

“能在最高点，在所有人都觉得还能再涨哪怕一个板的时候，挥刀自宫。这不叫疯子。”

“这叫没有感情的机器。”

顾城的话里，透着一种极其罕见的忌惮和敬佩。

在上海滩，他见过太多自诩股神的操盘手。但那些人，要么死在贪婪上，要么死在恐惧里。像林川这种，把人性弱点全部剥离出来的怪物，他第一次见。

林川弹了弹烟灰，嘴角勾起一抹弧度。

“股票玩的不就是人性吗？”

“两亿的盘子，我不切，庄家就切了。”

“钱在自己兜里，那才叫钱。”林川指了指自己的口袋，“在盘面上挂着，那叫一串数字。我这人比较俗，就喜欢落袋为安。”

顾城看着林川，忽然笑了起来。笑声越来越大，最后连眼泪都快笑出来了。

“俗？你要是俗，这世界上就没有雅人了。”

顾城端起酒杯，这次是双手。

“林川，我敬你一杯。”

这是顾城第一次，用这种平起平坐，甚至带着一丝尊重的姿态，敬酒。

林川举杯，一饮而尽。

服务员赶紧上前，重新添酒。她低着头，不敢多看，但心里已经掀起了惊涛骇浪。那个上海来的顾少，平时连这里的总经理都要看他脸色，现在居然主动给这个年轻人敬酒？还说他赚了一亿八千多万？这到底是什么神仙打架的局！

“其实我这次来深圳，本身就是半出差性质。”

顾城靠回沙发，语气变得随意起来。

The night wind is a bit strong.

The top terrace of a private yacht club in Shenzhen Bay.There was only one table on the dark gray antiseptic wooden floor.

Gu Cheng wore a dark casual suit, no tie, and the collar was slightly open.Lin Chuan was more casual, with his white shirt sleeves rolled up, and the Patek Philippe on his wrist glowed coldly under the dim spotlight.

On the table is a bottle of Romanée-Conti, a very good vintage.

The waiter came over carefully to pour the wine, his wrists slightly tight.She has worked in this club for two years and has met many big bosses.But the two people at this table today are too young.But there was a strong sense of oppression, especially the one in the white shirt.

Gu Cheng picked up the wine glass and swirled the dark red liquid.

"You've been causing quite a stir in Shenzhen lately."

Gu Cheng looked at Lin Chuan, his tone sounded like he was joking, but his eyes were deep.

Lin Chuan leaned on the sofa, holding a cigarette in one hand.

"Make some pocket money."

Lin Chuan picked up the cup and clinked it with Gu Cheng.The sound is crisp and clear.

"Pocket money?" Gu Cheng laughed angrily and took a sip of wine, "More than 185 million yuan in pocket money. Lin Chuan, with your appetite, not many people in Shenzhen or across the country dare to say that."

Lin Chuan didn't answer and took a puff of cigarette. The light blue smoke was quickly blown away by the sea breeze.

Gu Cheng put down his wine glass and leaned forward slightly.

"To be honest, you spent 10 million to buy Tencent shares. At first, I thought you had a vicious vision and were very courageous."

Gu Cheng stared into Lin Chuan's eyes.

"But I really don't understand Yi'an Technology's move. 30 million principal, all positions were invested. In the middle of three washes, the limit was touched, and you didn't even move. At this time, I thought you were a madman."

Gu Cheng shook his head.

"But yesterday afternoon, in those ten minutes at the end of the trading day, there were more than 180 million yuan in the market, and there were millions of slippage losses. You didn't even blink, and you just smashed the market price down regardless of the cost."

Gu Cheng took a deep breath.

"Being able to swing your sword at yourself at the highest point, when everyone thinks it can still rise even one level higher, is not crazy."

"This is called a machine without emotions."

There was an extremely rare fear and admiration in Gu Cheng's words.

In Shanghai, he has seen too many traders who claim to be stock gods.But those people either die of greed or fear.This was the first time he had seen a monster like Lin Chuan who had stripped away all the weaknesses of human nature.

Lin Chuan flicked the ash from his cigarette and raised the corners of his mouth.

“Isn’t it human nature that stocks play with?”

"If I don't cut the 200 million plate, the banker will cut it."

"It's money when it's in your pocket." Lin Chuan pointed to his pocket, "If it's hanging on the disk, it's called a string of numbers. I'm a rather vulgar person, and I like to be safe in my pocket."

Gu Cheng looked at Lin Chuan and suddenly laughed.The laughter got louder and louder, until finally I almost burst into tears.

"Vulgar? If you were vulgar, there would be no elegant people in this world."

Gu Cheng picked up the wine glass, this time with both hands.

"Linchuan, let me toast you."

This was the first time that Gu Cheng toasted with such an attitude of being on equal footing, even with a hint of respect.

Lin Chuan raised his glass and drank it all in one gulp.

The waiter hurriedly came forward and refilled the drink.She lowered her head, not daring to look further, but her heart was already filled with turmoil.That Mr. Gu from Shanghai, even the general manager here usually looks at his face, but now he actually takes the initiative to toast this young man?And he said he earned more than 180 million?What kind of fight between gods is this?

"Actually, my visit to Shenzhen this time is a semi-business trip."

Gu Cheng leaned back on the sofa and his tone became casual.
